## buddy-sbx run

Run an AI agent or container in an isolated sandbox

### Synopsis

Run provisions an isolated sandbox, streams the selected agent's terminal to the local terminal,
and handles port forwarding. When a local path is supplied, buddy-sbx uploads a filtered project snapshot
and synchronizes changes back after the agent exits. Codex project runs use the in-cluster provider broker.
Persistent project runs are retained by default. Detached runs start an idle container, not an agent process.

Supported presets:
  claude  - Runs Claude Code assistant
  codex   - Runs Buddy's version-pinned Codex image
  aider   - Runs Aider coding assistant
  shell   - Opens an interactive bash shell in an isolated environment

```
buddy-sbx run <preset|image> [local-path] [flags] [-- task args...]
```

### Examples

```
  # Run an ephemeral sandbox with interactive shell
  buddy-sbx run --name my-box --rm alpine:latest -- /bin/sh

  # Run a background detached sandbox with port mapping
  buddy-sbx run -d -p 8080:8080 --name web-agent node:20 -- npm start

  # Run with explicit resource requests and execution deadline
  buddy-sbx run --cpu 2000m --memory 4Gi --duration 30m python:3.11

  # Run with automated Git repository clone into persistent workspace
  buddy-sbx run --git-url https://github.com/org/repo.git --pvc my-pvc alpine:latest
```
